theorems.name: Submission.cbr_vl_riesz_measure_on_open
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (Λ : (Euclid P → ℝ) → ℝ), IsOpen U → (∀ f g : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → tsupport f ⊆ U → Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ U → Λ (f + g) = Λ f + Λ g) → (∀ (c : ℝ) (f : Euclid P → ℝ), Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → tsupport f ⊆ U → Λ (c • f) = c * Λ f) → (∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → tsupport f ⊆ U → (∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) → 0 ≤ Λ f) → ∃ μ : Measure (Euclid P), μ Uᶜ = 0 ∧ (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) ∧ ∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → tsupport f ⊆ U → ∫ x, f x ∂μ = Λ f
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
